name: Hydrodynamic Stability
description: Theory and applications of hydrodynamic stability, covering examples from nature and engineering. Topics include fundamentals of stability theory, bifurcations, and normal modes. Specific instabilities studied are Kelvin–Helmholtz, Rayleigh–Taylor, capillary instability of jets, Rayleigh–Bénard convection, and centrifugal instabilities such as Couette, Taylor–Dean, and Görtler flows. Electrohydrodynamic and magnetohydrodynamic instabilities are also discussed. Stability of plane parallel flows for both inviscid and viscous fluids, along with Rayleigh’s stability problem. Nonlinear stability: Landau’s theory, routes to chaos and turbulence.
